docs.title: CommonSENSES
docs.text: Welcome to the documentation hub for CommonSENSES — a customizable, low-cost, environmental sensing platform designed for field deployments.

docs.title: What are we trying to measure here?
docs.text: The logger is designed to measure temperature and sound in various environments.

docs.title: What’s in this site?
docs.text:
• Getting Started: What all is this system composed of? How to set up and deploy the system.
  • BOM & Production: Component lists and the costs for production.
  • CAD & Schematics: Mechanical design resources.
  • Datasheets: Reference datasheets for sensors and components.

For more info on the project goals and design philosophy, visit the GitHub Repository.

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text: This section will document the API endpoints, classes, and functions used.

docs.title: Bill of Materials (BOM)
docs.text: Here you’ll find the list of components and associated production costs for the CommonSENSES platform.
